title: Regression in 3.5.23: fails to parse ! in typescript

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Vue version

3.5.23

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://github.com/cyberalien/vue-3-5-23-bug

### Steps to reproduce

Run `npm run build`

### What is expected?

Expected to to compile

### What is actually happening?


### Any additional comments?

Bug is triggered by `!` on line 12 of App.vue

That's valid TypeScript syntax, even though it doesn't make sense in this code because this is reduced test case to show bug.

Worked fine in 3.5.22
